findings.title: listProposalsForTurns is fake-covered: an always-empty map survives, so the transcript's proposal cards and the snapshot's proposalSummaries are asserted nowhere
findings.arbiter_reasoning: Not equivalent and not an unexecuted branch. getConversationForOwner calls listProposalsForTurns on every transcript read (reads.ts:199) with a non-empty turnIds list in this test, and context.ts readRecentTurns calls it again for the snapshot (context.ts:288). The mutant returns an empty Map before issuing the statement, so (a) every OwnerConversationTurn.proposals becomes [], which the module's own docblock (reads.ts:113-119) says cannot be substituted by summary.pendingProposals because that list is pending-only and a superseded card still belongs to the sentence that proposed it; a stored `proposal` segment carries only an id, so the card it names simply vanishes from the transcript; and (b) SnapshotTurn.proposalSummaries goes back to [] — which is EXACTLY the pre-fix behaviour this commit changed (the round-1 tree hard-coded `proposalSummaries: []`). Searched for an oracle and found none: `rg proposalSummaries src worker` returns only the two production sites and no test; `rg '\.proposals\b' across the operator and route test suites returns one hit, turn-get-route.test.ts:71, which runs behind `vi.mock('@/lib/agents/operator/reads')` and therefore asserts the route's passthrough of a fixture. reads.integration.test.ts exercises the function but asserts only conversation ids, turn ids, sequences and ownerText. The sibling singular read (listProposalsForTurn, reached through getTurnForOwner) is unasserted in exactly the same way.

findings.title: projectOperatingRules' locationOverrideExists has no non-mocked oracle: forcing it to `true` on a location with no override row survives
findings.arbiter_reasoning: Not equivalent on this fixture and not an unexecuted branch. projectOperatingRules is the single owner of the inheritance projection introduced by this commit and runs on every call of both consumers — getConversationForOwner (reads.ts:257) and buildSnapshot (context.ts:356). The seeded tenant has no auto_approval_policies row for its location, so `override.exists` is false and the mutant reports the opposite. Per the function's own docblock, locationOverrideExists is row EXISTENCE and a distinct fact from inheritance: spec §4 says a dial-only change on a location with no row CREATES one, and the card must say so — so the mutant makes the owner-facing card, and the snapshot the model reasons from, state the reverse. Searched for an oracle: the only assertion on this field anywhere is conversation-route.test.ts:64, and that suite replaces '@/lib/agents/operator/reads' wholesale (line 19 of the retargeted mock), so the `false` it asserts is the fixture it set at line 47 — the same mock-driven shape round 1 flagged as F3/F4. The only live-DB assertion on the rules object is `vetoWindowMinutes > 0` (reads.integration.test.ts:261), which is why this survived; see finding R4.

findings.title: The new `if (!voice)` terminal branch — the location's voice row vanishing after authorization — ships with zero covering tests
findings.arbiter_reasoning: A production hunk this commit adds, with no identified covering candidate by reverse import search: no live-DB case archives the location or moves it to another account between reauthorizeTurn (step 3) and readVoiceConfig, and the only unit suite over handleAgentTurn stops at the flag gate. The branch is not cosmetic — it writes a FENCED terminal failure (failTurnFenced with reason `unauthorized`) plus the outbox completion, so a mistake here either strands a turn or fails one that should have completed. Recorded as an uncovered change (inventory row r2-16, inconclusive/oracle), not a survivor: there was nothing to run.

findings.title: Fragile assertion: `expect(summary.rules.vetoWindowMinutes).toBeGreaterThan(0)` is a range-shaped proxy for 'the panel reports this location's effective rules' — it is what let R2 survive
findings.arbiter_reasoning: A positive-number check passes for the account default, for the location override, and for any wrong-but-positive value, over a fixture that has no override row at all — so the whole inheritance projection and its `locationOverrideExists` companion are unconstrained. Behavioural replacement: seed an auto_approval_policies row for the turn's location whose dials DIFFER from the account default, then assert equality — `summary.rules` deep-equals the location's effective threshold, vetoWindowMinutes and dailyCap, and `summary.rules.locationOverrideExists` is true; add a second location with no row and assert it inherits the account default with locationOverrideExists false. That kills R2's mutant and pins the documented 'effective, never override' rule at the same time.

findings.title: context.test's closed-list guard no longer closes the list: buildSnapshot issues a fifth statement in production that this fixture can never see
findings.arbiter_reasoning: `expect(sqlCalls).toHaveLength(4)` carries the comment 'Not a count for its own sake — a fifth, unscoped read is exactly the regression this asserts against, so the list has to be closed.' This commit adds exactly such a fifth read (listProposalsForTurns, context.ts:288). The mocked sql returns [] for the recent-turns query, so turnIds is empty and the new function short-circuits without issuing a statement — the count stays 4 and the guard is silently blind to the read it was written to catch. Behavioural replacement: have the mock return at least one recent-turn row so the batched proposals read is issued, raise the expected count to 5, and assert the new call carries the account id like the other four.

findings.title: Missed sibling: the Version-token fix was applied to the reader only — updateVoiceConfig still returns `iso(row.updated_at)`, so the two spellings of the same token disagree by FORMAT
findings.arbiter_reasoning: Sibling search over the fixed pattern ('a Version token built from a postgres.js Date round-trip'), scope src/lib + worker excluding tests, pattern `updated_at` filtered to token/text/iso uses. readVoiceConfig now returns raw `updated_at::text` (e.g. `2026-09-11 10:00:00.123456+00`) and its docblock states the contract as 'Text end-to-end: the token stores this string and Run B's Apply compares text to text'. Forty lines below, updateVoiceConfig's `RETURNING updated_at` is still decoded to a JS Date and re-encoded by `iso()` (e.g. `2026-09-11T10:00:00.123Z`). Both are typed `updatedAt: string` and both are the location's voice **Version token**. In Run A nothing compares them — the PUT route only echoes the value — so this is not a live defect and not a P0; but a Run B Apply that takes the writer's return as the new token compares two different formats and can never match, and the truncation the fix exists to prevent is still present on that half. Excluded from the search by design: `account_updated_at` in worker/jobs/notification/context.ts and worker/jobs/publisher/load-context.ts, which are display/context values and not comparison tokens. Zero other siblings found.

findings.title: The new terminal failure path emits logger.warn only — no Sentry signal and no rule row in beta-launch-alerting.md
findings.arbiter_reasoning: Static comparison. The branch added at AgentTurnWorker.ts:198 is an operator-actionable TERMINAL failure (the turn dies `unauthorized` because a location disappeared mid-flight) and emits only `logger.warn('agent_turn location voice row vanished after authorization')`. `rg 'agent_turn|Owner Operator' docs/runbooks/beta-launch-alerting.md` returns no rule row for this subsystem, and `rg 'captureException|reportCaughtError|Sentry'` over worker/jobs/agent-turn + src/lib/agents/operator returns nothing. Held at P2, not P1: the five sibling terminal paths in the same handler (predecessor stalled, reauthorization failed, model output invalid, lease lost, budget exceeded) all pre-date this commit and all emit the same warn-only signal, so escalating the new line alone would be opening a front on unchanged code, which round 2 forbids. Recorded so the subsystem-wide alerting gap is adjudicated once, with Run A's go-live, rather than per line.

findings.title: The new status narrowings throw on an out-of-vocabulary value, and that throw branch has no test
findings.arbiter_reasoning: asTurnStatus and asProposalStatus were added so a driver-supplied bare string cannot widen back to `string`; the docblock is explicit that a value outside the vocabulary 'means the row was written by something that is not this codebase — a throw, not a silent widening'. The happy path is exercised (reads.integration asserts own.status === TURN_STATUS.ACCEPTED), but nothing asserts the throw, and mapStored's asProposalStatus call (proposals.ts:195) is reached in no non-mocked test at all. P2 rather than P1: these are defensive narrowings over a CHECK-constrained column, so the untested branch is unreachable in a healthy database — but it is the branch the functions exist for, and a one-line unit test in schema.test.ts closes it.
